newsitem.title: UK: UK B/socs net new approvals s/a 3.343 bln in Jan.
newsitem.headline: UK B/socs net new approvals s/a 3.343 bln in Jan.

text.p: The UK Building Societies Association (BSA) released the following, seasonally adjusted, data on lending -
MORTGAGE ADVANCES AND NEW APPROVALS TO LEND
NOTES - approval = borrower accepts offer of advance; advance = actual loan, on average some 10 wks after commitment; advances tend to reflect new approvals made 2 or 3 mths ago.
The Building Societies Association said the 1,091 million stg rise in retail inflow in the savings market was the biggest monthly increase since April 1991.
"Building society net lending increased on the previous month on both a seasonally adjusted and unadjusted basis," said Adrian Coles, director-general of the BSA.

"Despite the slight fall in gross advances and approvals, there is every indication that the recovery in the housing market is continuing with net advances up 32 percent on the same month a year ago."
